(a) the growing emphasis on accountability in tertiary education is likely to be a mixed blessing; (b) it is important to ensure that accountability practices are credible; (c) it is also important to ensure that autonomy conditions are favorable; and (d) a balance between these two factors is likely to be the best way to ensure the successful evolution of the tertiary education sector.

(1) the accountability agenda in tertiary sector is a growing phenomenon; (2) the accountability agenda is a double-edged sword, as it can have positive as well as negative effects; and (3) the most effective accountability mechanism is one that is mutually agreed or is voluntarily adopted by tertiary education institutions themselves.
